item.title: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Models for Healthcare Staffing and Shift Scheduling
item.description:
Overview Formulating advanced mixed-integer programming algorithms to solve NP-hard hospital nurse and physician scheduling problems.

Problem Motivation Traditional heuristic scheduling often results in suboptimal coverage, increased fatigue, and higher operational costs.

Methodology Developed a novel branch-and-price framework that efficiently solves the large-scale MILP formulation of the staffing problem.

Key Findings The algorithm produces near-optimal schedules that reduce operational costs by 8% while strictly satisfying all union and clinical constraints.
